> Hello everyone.
> Just looking for opinions on this deck. I tried to modify it according
> to my playgroup, so comments are welcome.

According to your playgroup? We'll need to know about about that
playgroup to give you location specific advice.

Here's a version of the deck I played:
http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/82495fb7b1596a72

> Crypt [11 vampires] Capacity min: 1 max: 11 average: 6.27273
> ------------------------------------------------------------
> 4x Enkidu, The Noah     11 ANI CEL OBF POT PRO for   !Gangrel:4
> 3x Petra                        5  ANI OBF aus Nosferatu:4
> 3x T.J.                          3  cel for        Gangrel:4
> 1x Kai Simmons            1  cel Pander:4

Diversity among the support minions is critical. Forced March is the
least critical thing for you to be able to cycle with your other
vampires, I went with more minions with superior Animalism to acquire
backup Raptors.

> Library [90 cards]
> ------------------------------------------------------------
> Action [6]
>   1x Army of Rats
>   2x Constant Revolution
>   2x Feline Saboteur
>   1x Shadow of the Beast

Feline Saboteur doesn't do enough for you. These could be Deep Song,
if you have them.

> Action Modifier [9]
>   3x Forced March
>   3x Forgotten Labyrinth
>   1x Hidden Lurker
>   2x Lost in Crowds

Drop the Hidden Lurker, you really can't afford to waste Enkidu on
that.

> Combat [40]
>   4x Earth Meld
>   5x Pack Alpha
>   13x Psyche!
>   3x Pursuit
>   1x Quick Meld
>   6x Skin of Steel
>   4x Superior Mettle
>   4x Taste of Vitae

I'd increase the Earth Meld for the free untap, since you plan to
restart combat with the Psyche! anyway. Hit your opponents with the
discard tech twice per action.

> Master [17]
>   1x Campground Hunting Ground
>   1x Carver's Meat Packing and Storage
>   1x Dreams of the Sphinx
>   3x Fortitude
>   1x Giant's Blood
>   2x Guardian Angel
>   2x Heidelberg Castle, Germany
>   1x Rack, The
>   1x Slum Hunting Ground
>   2x Vessel
>   2x Villein

Vessel's are too slow. You need anti-Pentex tech. Replace those with
Sudden Reversal. You will be removed the turn Enkidu is Pentexed, so
you have to prevent that.

> Reaction [3]
>   3x Cats' Guidance

Sense the Savage Way instead.

> Retainer [15]
>   2x Homunculus
>   13x Raptor

> And one more question-can Enkidu use "Dartmoor, England" (since it
> represents a location)?

Yes.

afford something like that.

>
> Action Modifier [9]
>   3x Forced March

prevent cards that also serve other purposes. Oh and add some more
taste of vitae if you can. And more
pack alphas. You dont have any untap reactions -only homunculus - so

from it that I want. So I have taken it out (in spite of the fact that
I have added dragonbound to my version, which it combos nicely with).

I would suggest adding some untap or wake reactions.

Messages.Author: ira...@gmail.com
Messages.Body:


What is your plan to oust your prey with this deck? You have strong
combat, but very weak ousting mechanism. I recommend allotting 10-15
cards to doing pool damage to your prey. The way you win is by
ousting your prey and not getting ousted yourself. Simply torporing
all your prey's vampires doesn't cause you to win (usually it causes
your grand-prey to win.)

Cards you may want to consider:
1-2 Tension in the Ranks
2-3 Fame
0-1 Path of Lilith
3-5 Deep Song (you can using Enkidu's built-in rush, Earth Meld to
untap, Psyche!, beat up a minion, then rush again with Deep Song.)
1 Dragonbound

Also, since you are a combat deck and your chances of victory increase
as you get more setup, you might want to include cards that help
everyone:
The Coven
Powerbase: Montreal

You might also want to include Form of Mist, since it's a great combat
card + action modifier.

You might also want to include damage prevention cards that don't cost
blood, like Leathery Hide, Soak, or Skin of Rock, and/or flexible
cards like Rolling with the Punches. I like Sideslip as well so you
can dodge entirely.

Instead of Quick Meld, you might consider Canine Horde instead, to
deal with pesky guns that will shoot your Raptors.

Also, you should realize that 1-3 Raptors actually help your
opponents, because they will be able to cycle to cards they need to
deal with the situation at hand. 4-5 is about a wash, and 6-7 does
start hurting. You should aim to rush your allies at first, and
promise not to hit them (either manuever long or end combat). Since
you aren't trying Brinksmanship, and you really do want to torpor
people, you might consider getting rid of the Raptors entirely, since
2 blood is quite expensive. You could replace with Murder of Crows,
Raven Spy's, and Owl Companions. Your combat would likely be more
effective (Murder of Crows is powerful), and the blood cost would be
lower.

I would increase to at least 5x Enkidu, if not 6x Enkidu, and then use
a few Wider Views. With 4x Enkidu, you'll miss him in your opening
crypt ~1 in 7 games.

Not enough Raptors. At all. You need 8-10, simply because some monkey

Messages.Author: ZaraZ
Messages.Body:


The deck is compressed to a maximum - there simply is no space for
another Raptor. +1hs doesn't really matter. What's anyone going to do
with one card in their hand when in combat with Enkidu, especially
when he's got access to combat cards starting another combat or even
saving his ass if need be? Besides, soon enough everyone is running
out of cards, since they need to discard at least seven cards to even
try to mess with him.
If I were to add anything to it at the moment, it would probably be
Monster and/or Sense the Savage Way, but I would have a hard time
picking cards to get rid of, cause the deck needs to keep the 60 cards
count.

That's exactly what DI is for :)
Worst case scenario - you bring them back with ATs and start again ;)

> This is why you need to make many raptors, very very very fast.

Infernal Pursuit+Pack Alpha+Psyche is the fastest way I have found so
far - this deck my best working example.

> You somehow need to refill the vamp, or make him pay less for the
> raptors.
> Ekiddu can do this via the fairly efficient method blur and taste on
> big buggers.

Blur is limited to additional strikes only and has a blood cost.
Pursuit can be used for maneuver (which can help you cycle with
Infernal Pursuit or set the preferred range) or additional strike.
Enkidu hits for six with a single additional strike, that's enough to
employ another 3 Raptors.
If you feel fairly safe from combat it's best to employ as many as
possible while cycling to draw Giant's Blood, leave Enkidu low on
blood. Risky, but worth a try.
